articles.description: In Joe Klanderman's first game as interim coach, Baylor improved to 5-3 overall, 3-2 in the Big 12, with a 41-9 rout of UCF on Friday night, a convincing Bears' victory that snapped the Knights' four-game home winning streak.

article.story: No. 25 Wisconsin (5-2) at Iowa (5-2), Oct. 31 at 12 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Iowa by 3.5. Against the spread: Iowa 4-3, Wisconsin 4-3. How to watch: FOX Key stats Iowa Offense Overall: 386.7 yards per game (68th in FBS) Passing: 207.6 yards per game (91st) Rushing: 179.1 yards per game (47th) Scoring: 28.0 points per game (75th) Iowa Defense Overall: 281.3 yards per game (14th in FBS) Passing: 198.4 yards per game (49th) Rushing: 82.9 yards per game (5th) Scoring: 14.3 points per game (8th) Wisconsin Offense Overall: 330.1 yards per game (118th in FBS) Passing: 179.4 yards per game (119th) Rushing: 150.7 yards per game (78th) Scoring: 27.0 points per game (80th) Wisconsin Defense Overall: 280.1 yards per game (13th in FBS) Passing: 183.6 yards per game (31st) Rushing: 96.6 yards per game (15th) Scoring: 15.3 points per game (11th) Iowa is 17th in FBS in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert on 30.8% of third downs. Wisconsin is 9th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 95.2% of trips. Wisconsin ranks 113th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 28:23. Team leaders Iowa Passing: Hank Brown, 968 yards, 6 TDs, 3 INTs, 61.4 completion percentage Rushing: Kamari Moulton, 541 yards on 86 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: Tony Diaz, 386 yards on 29 catches, 1 TD Wisconsin Passing: Colton Joseph, 1,256 yards, 11 TDs, 5 INTs, 57.2 completion percentage Rushing: Joseph, 365 yards on 84 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: Tyrell Henry, 343 yards on 28 catches, 1 TD Last game Iowa fell 13-10 to Minnesota on Oct. 24. Brown threw for 136 yards on 11-of-21 attempts (52.4%) with one touchdown and two interceptions. L.J. Phillips Jr. had 25 rushing yards on seven carries, adding one reception for eight yards. Reece Vander Zee put up 69 yards on four catches with one touchdown. Wisconsin won 24-7 over USC on Oct. 24. Joseph led Wisconsin with 58 yards on 12-of-14 passing (85.7%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 15 times for 32 yards. Abu Sama III had 71 rushing yards on 17 carries, adding two receptions for seven yards. Eugene Hilton Jr. put up 18 yards on three catches. Next game Iowa plays at No. 20 Northwestern on Nov. 7. Wisconsin hosts Rutgers on Nov. 7.
